requirements.label: Choose 6 credits
requirements.text: Complete 6 credits from the following courses:
notes: Or any courses with the following prefix: GEOG, SURV, GIS, EGDT subject to department approval

CS 1400.title: Fundamentals of Programming
CS 1400.prereqText: Math at least equivalent to high school algebra and trigonometry. CS 1030 recommended.

GEOG 3400.title: Environmental Remote Sensing
GEOG 3400.prereqText: GEOG 3600 ; STAT 2040 ; an upper division course in natural science recommended; and University Advanced Standing

GEOG 3440.title: Geospatial Data Science
GEOG 3440.prereqText: GEOG 3600 , STAT 2040 , and University Advanced Standing

GEOG 3600.title: Introduction to Geographic Information Systems
GEOG 3600.prereqText: [Completion of a course that meets the PP (Physical Science) or SS (Social Science) general education requirement is recommended] and University Advanced Standing

GEOG 4100.title: Geospatial Field Methods
GEOG 4100.prereqText: GEOG 3600 and MATH 1060 ; University Advanced Standing

GEOG 4820R.title: GIS Internship
GEOG 4820R.prereqText: ( GEOG 3600 and GEOG 3650 or equivalent), department approval, declared major in any Earth Science program, and University Advanced Standing

GEOG 4890R.title: Student Research in Geography
GEOG 4890R.prereqText: Junior or Senior standing, instructor approval, and University Advanced Standing

GIS 3630.title: Geographic Information Systems Application Development
GIS 3630.prereqText: GIS 2800 or GEOG 3600 and University Advanced Standing

SURV 1220.title: Remote Sensing and Photogrammetry
SURV 1220.prereqText: MAT 1010 or appropriate math placement score, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program

SURV 2100.title: Mapping From Field to Finish
SURV 2100.prereqText: EGDT 1400 , EGDT 1040 , and EGDT 1600 or MATH 1060 or equivalent, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.

SURV 3210.title: Advanced Photogrammetry
SURV 3210.prereqText: EGDT 1400 , SURV 1220 , MATH 1060 , or ( EGDT 1600 and 1610 ), or appropriate math placement score, and University Advanced Standing, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.

SURV 3250.title: Geodesy
SURV 3250.prereqText: SURV 1030 , 2100 , MATH 1060 or EGDT 1600 and 1610 or appropriate math placement score, and University Advanced Standing, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.
